A '''Squib tourist''' visited [[Piringiisi]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sullust/Legends|Sullust]] only to be the victim of a [[Dianoga/Legends|dianoga]] attack. The [[Squib/Legends|Squib]] survived and notified the authorities of the hazard in the mud pits.<ref name="Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds">''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''</ref>
